method: Read source PDFs via pdftotext physical pages 2024 3,5,6,7 and 2026 4,5,7; independently rendered and visually inspected 2024 pages 6 and 7 and 2026 pages 4 and 5, including figure labels and notes. Inspected 16 stored observation rows and compared with source passages; checked hashes already in verification. Did not run extraction or protected-output scripts.

findings.2024_population: 2021/22 dual apprenticeships; source p3 reports 188284 initial, 184964 after missing locations, 174868 after adult exclusion. Entry age at most 25 and adults from 25 overlap in original prose; preserve ambiguity.
findings.2024_school: p5 estimates fastest available vocational-school municipality in occupation, with home-canton preference; actual school is unknown. p6 states municipality-level average public-transport travel is approximate.
findings.2024_travel: p6 estimated one-way means ~39 employer / ~46 assigned vocational school; p7 below 60 minutes ~85% / ~77%. Both figures omit over 120 minutes, and p6/p7 state ~1.4% / 2.1% exceed 120: plotting truncation is not a hard support cap.
findings.2026_definition: p4 174868 ongoing dual contracts, learner not older than 25 at entry; p5 selects origins with at least one resident under 25 in ongoing 2021/22 apprenticeship. Do not silently equate boundaries. 60 minutes is an assumed one-way public-transport search radius.
findings.2026_vacancies: p4 says a contract is observed only if employer and learner enter a relationship; unfilled places are absent. Search-space counts are observed filled contracts, not current vacancies.
findings.2026_examples: p7 Olten 242 municipalities, 12704 employers, 49484 contracts, 227 occupations; Brusio 2,24,38,18. 84% of search spaces have more than 100 occupations; 4.4% of young apprentices live in spaces with fewer than 100. Denominators and strict inequalities differ.
findings.provenance_and_scope: 16 rows match reported numbers. These national and municipality-example results describe 2021/22 data in 2024/2026 reports; they are neither Zurich-city travel-time measurements nor 2025 measurements, and do not establish exact age-14 versus age-18 differences.

limits: No access to original individual-level SBG-BUR linkage, routing matrix or reproduction of EHB calculation.
Visual review limited to physical pages 2024 6-7 and 2026 4-5; other requested passages checked by text extraction.

binding_refresh.scope: Read-only check of revised source list, saved receipts, added README, verification and existing outputs; no capture or extract script run.
binding_refresh.change: capture.py SOURCES now matches four saved receipt URLs including the 2024 PDF; README is included in updated verification source map.
